newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Friday on thin buying interest, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,410-15 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at five rupiah below the market range. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,240 rupiah/kg and 1,243 rupiah/kg at tenders in the North Sumatran city of Medan last Wednesday.
"The market was not very active as election results were being announced," one trader said. "Some players were cautious over possible unrest, but I think that feeling is waning."
President Suharto's ruling Golkar party has taken an unassailable lead, garnering more than 73 percent of some 100 million votes counted by the early afternoon on Friday.

The market was subdued over the 27-day campaign period, which was marred by the worst political violence in some 30 years. Traders said they expected the market to return to normal over the next two weeks.
"The market will find its feet possibly over the next two weeks," one trader said. "It will need some time to recover."
